title: Regulatory Mechanisms of Salinity-Induced Triterpenoid Saponin Biosynthesis in Cyclocarya paliurus Seedling Revealed by Integrated Multi-Omics Analysis and Molecular Docking.
authors: Hong, Kun; Chen, Hui; Qin, Jian; Fang, Shengzuo; Shang, Xulan; Zhang, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与分子对接研究盐胁迫下青钱柳三萜皂苷生物合成调控，涉及转录因子与靶基因启动子的结合验证，但核心是代谢调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅用分子对接，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Soil salinity is a major environmental constraint limiting plant productivity and modulating secondary metabolism. Triterpenoid saponins play crucial roles in plant stress adaptation, yet their biosynthetic regulation in Cyclocarya paliurus under salt stress remains poorly understood. This research integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses to investigate triterpenoid saponin metabolism in C. paliurus leaves at four NaCl concentrations and two sampling times. Salt stress altered ion homeostasis, suppressed growth, and induced distinct triterpenoid saponins accumulation patterns, with cyclocaric acid B and oleanolic acid showing significant increases. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis identified two modules significantly correlated with triterpenoid saponin accumulation and highlighted transcription factors including WRKY18, bHLH121, ERF4, and ERF1 as regulators of key biosynthetic genes (DXS, SQS, and HMGR). Molecular docking further validated these regulatory interactions, demonstrating that bHLH35, MYC2, ERF113, and MED26B form stable complexes with target gene promoters through extensive hydrogen-bond networks. These findings elucidate the regulatory framework of triterpenoid saponin metabolism under salinity and provide a foundation for molecular breeding and cultivation of C. paliurus in saline regions.
abstract_zh: 土壤盐分是限制植物生产力并调节次生代谢的主要环境制约因素。三萜皂苷在植物逆境适应中发挥关键作用，然而其在盐胁迫下青钱柳（Cyclocarya paliurus）中的生物合成调控仍知之甚少。本研究整合转录组学和代谢组学分析，探讨了在四种NaCl浓度和两个采样时间下青钱柳叶片中三萜皂苷的代谢情况。盐胁迫改变了离子稳态，抑制了生长，并诱导了显著的三萜皂苷积累模式，其中环果酸B（cyclocaric acid B）和齐墩果酸（oleanolic acid）显著增加。加权基因共表达网络分析（weighted gene co-expression network analysis）鉴定出两个与三萜皂苷积累显著相关的模块，并突出转录因子如WRKY18、bHLH121、ERF4和ERF1作为关键生物合成基因（DXS、SQS和HMGR）的调控因子。分子对接进一步验证了这些调控相互作用，证明bHLH35、MYC2、ERF113和MED26B通过广泛的氢键网络与靶基因启动子形成稳定复合物。这些发现阐明了盐分条件下三萜皂苷代谢的调控框架，并为青钱柳在盐碱地区的分子育种和栽培提供了基础。
